name: duounwan-rules-tests
description: Emulator tests for firestore.rules (and the staged firestore.rules.next), storage.rules and the Cloud Functions triggers.

scripts.emulators:rules-next: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.next.json --only firestore,storage --project demo-duounwan "npm run test:next"
scripts.emulators:functions: npm --prefix ../functions run build && PATH="${JAVA_HOME:+$JAVA_HOME/bin:}$PATH" npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-duounwan "npm run test:functions"
